assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: ready

## Reasoning

A turn's model call fails and the agent gives up. Probed with the repo's mock-openai-error at its defaults (HTTP 503 `server_error`/`overloaded`, every request — /Users/factory/.oc2sb/qa/p5b2-work/probe/2-14-mock.log): 2.x retried for about 80s (12 requests, the title's included), writing nothing to the store meanwhile but the user row, then wrote an assistant row with `finish: error` and an `idle` row, outcome `failed`, error `{type: provider.internal, status: 503, message: "Provider overloaded (mock)."}`. parser_v2.go turns the failed idle into SessionError, the plugin forwards `session.execution.failed` (a Stop hook), and the classifier routes a turn that ended in failure to the error state.

## Wire check

The final per-cell config, with every provider's baseURL pointed at a local capture stub (/Users/factory/.oc2sb/qa/p5b2-work/probe/wire-2-14-final.log): the title and the turn both named `mock-openai-error-model`; nothing named the Kolibri path, so no request reaches the local model.
caveats: The ~80s retry window is 2.x's own policy (the AI SDK alone retries twice); the spec gives the failure no upper bound beyond the cell deadline.

sources.note: each assistant row's model.id is the step's ModelName; text items feed applyAssistantText (task-estimate scan)
2.x hook receiver: permission.asked holds waiting, session.execution.{succeeded,failed,interrupted} end the turn through HandleStopHook (#2108)
a turn that ended with a SessionError → error
probe: 503 retried ~80s, then idle failed, error.type provider.internal
wire check of the final config: every request named mock-openai-error-model

preconditions: One OpenCode 2.x `serve --service` running, with a model it can reach (this host: the sandbox service, local Kolibri-1 4-bit model (mlx_lm) at 127.0.0.1:8087); the rig never starts, stops or reconfigures it
The three XDG exports, coexist IRRLICHT_ONBOARD_HOME and a non-7837 bind address from replaydata/agents/opencode-v2/prerequisites.md; OPENCODE_DB unset

The repo's mock-openai-error running at 127.0.0.1:18806 for the whole run (default flags: every request fails with HTTP 503 server_error / overloaded); it serves the mock provider's turns, so they never reach the local model. Build: go build -o .build/refresh/bin/mock-openai-error ./tools/onboarding-factory/recording/mock-openai-error/
setup: driver-interactive.sh (API driver) refuses before creating anything unless exactly one `serve --service` runs, its environment carries the run's XDG_* values, and the plugin's beacon resolves this run's daemon

It creates one session over POST /api/session at <staging>/cwd, waits for the service log to show the plugin the daemon installed loading for that location with no load failure, then drives the script; the session's session_message rows are exported read-only as the transcript
mock provider `mockerror` declared in RUN_CWD/opencode.json (baseURL 127.0.0.1:18806) and set as the session's model; the shell is denied
one turn; every model request fails with HTTP 503

script.text: Reply with exactly the word: ok

verify: working on the prompt, through 2.x's retries
the turn ends in error after the last retry, and the session stays in error
the transcript's idle row is outcome failed
